title: You should checkout what we are doing with webmention badges, you can convert them easily to open badges spec but I like a badge built on a single HTM
summary: You should checkout what we are doing with webmention badges, you can convert them easily to open badges spec but I like a badge built on a single HTMl file with no javascript. See no need for blockchain. Solution without problem.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
You should checkout what we are doing with webmention badges, you can convert them easily to open badges spec but I like a badge built on a single HTMl file with no javascript.

See no need for blockchain. Solution without problem.
